A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same LocFT-BF study. Their complete main texts, appendices, tables, figures, and mathematical content support reliable comparison after matching relocated and renumbered material.

before.justification: v3 reports original pipeline, batch-size, tuning-location, benchmarking, and scaling experiments, plus appendix results on MoE models, medical editing, and data augmentation.

after.justification: v4 retains those empirical results and adds LlamaFactory and FullFT comparisons and a combined 100K-edit, 72B-model experiment.

M1.justification: The original breadth-first, mini-batch, localized editing procedure remains unchanged. Appendix A.5 adds a LlamaFactory implementation using token-level loss averaging rather than the original implementation's sample-level averaging, introducing a limited procedural variant.

E1.justification: The editing datasets, medical domain, QAEdit/MoE evaluation, and capability tasks are retained. The new experiments use existing coverage with different implementations or model/sample configurations. WMT16 was already specified in v3 Appendix A.1.4.

E2.justification: New Table 8 explicitly compares FullFT implemented in LlamaFactory against localized tuning across the three main datasets and models. v3 Section 3 mentions excluded full-parameter trials but provides no corresponding comparison. Existing baseline memberships are retained.

E3.justification: Section 5.2 adds the joint configuration of 100K ZsRE edits on Qwen2.5-72B; v3 tested 100K edits on smaller models and 72B with 1,000 edits separately. Appendix A.5 also adds framework-replication and full-parameter control experiments using the existing benchmark design.

E4.justification: Appendix A.5 adds a cross-framework robustness check and quantitative comparison of localized versus full-parameter tuning. These extend the existing analyses of pipeline, batch size, tuning location, augmentation, and scalability without replacing them.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, or statistical significance tests. The new discussion of variation between implementations does not introduce statistical uncertainty estimation.

E6.justification: Existing numerical tables and plotted results are retained, but v4 adds substantial results for LlamaFactory-localized tuning and FullFT across all nine main dataset/model combinations. For example, Table 8 reports LLaMA3-8B/COUNTERFACT generalization of 71.53 for the LF variant alongside the retained original value of 33.23; these are different implementations. Section 5.2 additionally reports 99.80% reliability, 57.60% generalization, and 62.54% capability for 100K edits on Qwen2.5-72B.

T1.justification: The formal model-editing definition and layer-selection reasoning are retained. No mathematical definitions, assumptions, theorems, proofs, or derivations are added or substantively revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about flawed fine-tuning implementations, localized breadth-first editing, baseline superiority, and scaling to 100K edits and 72B models. The new experiments supply additional support without redefining these contributions.

C2.justification: Appendix A.5 newly attributes cross-framework performance differences to loss averaging and engineering infrastructure, and interprets FullFT capability losses as severe overfitting that prevents practical continuous editing. Section 2.5 also makes the latency distinction between immediate updates and buffered updates explicit.

D1.justification: v4 adds a code-repository link and reproducibility statement, documents LlamaFactory integration and loss averaging, and newly specifies appending EOS tokens to every method's target answers. The PDFs do not establish that this EOS disclosure reflects rerunning the retained experiments.

R1.justification: v4 adds citations to LlamaFactory, HybridFlow, and The Fall of ROME to support implementation and capability-evaluation discussion. Section 6's research positioning remains unchanged; other reference edits largely shorten metadata or update publication information.

P1.justification: v4 revises Section 2.5 and several introductory passages, changes author order and header text, and adds acknowledgments, ethics, reproducibility, and LLM-usage statements. The new appendix subsection shifts the old A.5 to A.6; the main narrative structure is retained.

P2.justification: v4 adds the LlamaFactory/FullFT Table 8 and renumbers the previous Table 8 as Table 9. Existing displays are repositioned or resized, including Table 1 and Figures 2–3, and conference headers are added. The retained displays preserve their scientific content.

improvement.justification: v4 strengthens an already extensive empirical study through quantitative FullFT controls, cross-framework validation, and a joint 100K-edit/72B test that connects previously separate scaling demonstrations. The code-access information and EOS disclosure improve reproducibility documentation. These benefits outweigh limited interpretive overreach: Appendix A.5's categorical rejection of FullFT is broader than its Qwen capability results support, and the framework comparison does not isolate the causes of performance differences.
